summary: US government takes a 9.9% Intel stake: $8.9B for 433.3M shares at $20.47, funded by unpaid CHIPS grants and Secure Enclave money.
notes: Funded by $5.7B of awarded but unpaid CHIPS grants plus $3.2B of Secure Enclave funds, so Intel's CHIPS grant is not a separate edge. The shares were issued; some sit in escrow and are released as Secure Enclave cash arrives (132M still in escrow at September 26, 2026, per Intel's 10-Q), so the amount stays committed. Includes a five-year warrant for 5% more at $20 that applies only if Intel's foundry ownership drops below 51%. Announced date taken from the exhibit's file name.
